features.title: Choose an agent preset before typing
features.summary: The native new-task preset chip changes a client-local draft's metadata without creating a Host Session or calling agentPresets.select for a nonexistent id. Settings defaults and both Creator routes use the same controller. Materialized blank Sessions retain the native Host selection path; started Sessions keep their recorded composition.
failureModes: A missing sessionDrafts service keeps this row pending instead of calling the Host for a local identity.
A refused Host selection keeps the native refusal toast and restores the recorded caption.
A Creator navigation cannot spend its staged preset on the previous local blank.

externalDependencies.boundary: The canonical draft-client service owns local identities, preset metadata and materialization through native SessionCreateRequest.agentPreset.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Focused controller tests supply the public SessionDrafts contract and assert local staging versus materialized Host selection.

telemetry.reason: Client-only native row replacement; preset and Settings operations retain their existing native RPC instrumentation.

verification.testName: selects a local preset without a per-id Host RPC and keeps its caption on reload
does not spend a Creator stage onto the previous local blank while navigation publishes the new identity
